sentences.en: Let him be a great statesman, I don't admire him.
sentences.zh: 让他成为一个伟大的政治家吧，我不欣赏他。

sentences.en: There was no one that did not admire the boy.
sentences.zh: 没有一个人不赞赏这个男孩的。

sentences.en: He is such a great artist that we all admire.
sentences.zh: 他是一个如此伟大的艺术家，我们都钦佩他。

mnemonic: ad（一再）+mire（高兴）→一再让人惊喜
